courses.web_development: Do you want to build a website, application or need support in one of your project?

portfolio.title: Welcome to my portfolio!
portfolio.subtitle: Here, you'll find a collection of web design and development projects that showcase my passion for creating clean, functional, and visually engaging websites. Each project reflects my commitment to providing innovative solutions tailored to the unique needs of my clients.
portfolio.hero1_desc: Real-estate platform built from the ground up with a fully dynamic CMS-style admin where content, listings and imagery can be updated in real time. Delivered a polished, responsive UX tuned for mobile browsing.
portfolio.hero2_desc: Bespoke real-estate website coded directly without a CMS. Custom design and tailored logic provide a dynamic, client-editable structure that adapts content based on user interaction.

descriptions.Starlux: End-to-end build for a lighting brand: shipped the complete front and back end implementation matching the design system to the pixel.
descriptions.Chytré střechy: Created from scratch for a Czech roofing company — faithful UX/UI implementation plus the supporting back-end required to keep content editable.

descriptions.Desafío Latam: Tech tutor for aspiring full-stack developers — taught React and Node.js fundamentals and ran code reviews across student capstone projects.
descriptions.Grime Fighters: Developed the full site for a Canadian cleaning-services company. Clean HTML/CSS front end backed by solid, maintainable logic.
descriptions.Pronachem: Rebuilt the homepage — banners, calls-to-action and editable content blocks — and sharpened the responsive behavior for better mobile flow.
descriptions.Ekoplant: Modernized the homepage and its editable content surface, plus improved responsive behavior so the marketing team can self-serve updates.
descriptions.MYJOYS: Refreshed the homepage for a German bathroom-goods brand, shipping editable banners and intuitive UI updates for a smoother shopping flow.
